text: STU-006 has now been reported three times (author-study iterations 2, 4 and 5) and cannot be cleared by any stage the run will reach again unless a blocking finding routes to research: research/interpretations.md section 3 does not record Thomas Aquinas (Super Phil. c. 4 on Dan 9:18) among the third reading's witnesses, while the component manifest declares him and the study develops him. Every reviewer has judged it advisory, and every author has correctly refused to edit a sealed research record. The driver leaves it standing as a known record-completeness gap rather than manufacturing a blocking finding to force a research re-entry; it is recorded in the leaf's standing-findings file and will be stated in the production record and put to the final cold review.
